comparability: These controls were built and run on 2026-10-10. The detections they qualify were measured on 2026-09-18, before the 17.5 re-pin, on a build that no longer exists. Same sources and same patch set, but a rebuild is not byte-identical, so a control holding today is evidence about this build's behaviour on these programs and not a replay of the run it qualifies.
retries: Three arms came back norun on the first pass and one on the second -- exit 75, the guest runner's infrastructure flake. They were rerun until they produced a measurement rather than being scored; a norun is not a verdict in either direction.
